name: week
title: This week
subtitle: What needs a person: overdue tasks, uncollected assets, claim notices, quiet files

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.note: From v_attention. Days are counted from the date shown; negative means still to come.
sections.sql: select ref, owner, item, detail, date, days from v_attention order by days desc

sections.title: Open tasks
sections.sql: select e.ref, t.title, t.owner, t.due_on from tasks t join estates e on e.id = t.estate_id where t.done_on is null order by t.due_on nulls last

name: windows
title: Distribution windows
subtitle: When each open estate can distribute, and when its claims period ends

sections.title: Open estates
sections.note: Rules and sources: docs/compliance.md. Other states show 'rule not configured' until you add their rule.
sections.sql: select ref, deceased_name as deceased, jurisdiction, grant_date, protected_from, claim_period_ends, live_claims, window_status from v_windows where status <> 'closed' order by ref

sections.title: Claims and notices of intention
sections.sql: select ref, claimant, kind, status, notice_received_on, filed_on, served_on, lapses_on, live from v_claims_live order by live desc, ref

name: money
title: Money held
subtitle: Cash in each estate account against the debts still to pay

sections.title: Estate accounts
sections.sql: select ref, deceased_name as deceased, responsible, currency, receipts_cents, payments_cents, distributed_cents, cash_held_cents, unpaid_liabilities_cents, assets_to_collect from v_position where status <> 'closed' order by cash_held_cents desc
